tool: Codex CLI 0.169.0 (codex exec), built-in image generation tool image_gen.imagegen, ChatGPT sign-in
image_model: not exposed by the Codex image tool
prompt:
Use your image generation tool, with the attached image as the reference to edit/trace (keep its composition).
Make ONE image: full colour manga setting art (character/setting sheet), clean even thin black main line, flat cel colours (no gradients, no painterly texture, minimal shading).
Early-18th-century English clothes and ships. No likeness to any film, game or existing illustration.
Keep the reference's proportions, pose, camera angle and framing exactly; same position and size in the frame. Landscape orientation 1536x1024.

Fill the whole frame, including sky.
No text, no speech balloons, no signature, no watermark.
Subject: The ancient temple outside the west gate of Mildendo, the tiny Lilliputian capital, where Gulliver lodges: abandoned weathered stone temple, its gate only 4 ft high and 2 ft wide, early-morning light, grass and trees of Lilliputian scale around it. The buildings are small in the frame: keep the composition but add detail mainly around the buildings.
After generating, copy the generated PNG to ./raw.png in the current directory. Do not generate more than one image.
post_processing: _tools/split.py: cover-fit and centre-cropped to the underlay size; line layer = thin dark strokes (morphological close minus luminance), fill layer = image with strokes inpainted. Composite = un-split image at underlay size.
